entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-04
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Add an item template for creating launch profile JSON files (launchSettings.json/app.run.json) #52023
  • [StaticWebAssets] Provide the ability to pass additional assets via an MSBuild property at build/publish time #52019
  • [dotnet-watch] Allow restarting a specific project on Cltr+R in an Aspire app #52018
  • `dotnet package update` should respect NuGet version semantics #52017
  • Improve the user experience when waiting for long-running Target invocations in `dotnet run` and other interactive experiences #52016
  • PublishSingleFile publish fails when XML docs are generated but not copied to the output directory #52015
  • TextTransformCore uses runtime (not ref) assemblies during build #52012

Closed

  • Consider using `PublishAot` for Mobile Platforms and Blazor WASM #25392
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/9.0.3xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #51923
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/8.0.4xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #51913
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/8.0.3xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #51912
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/9.0.1xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #51973
  • Cancelling tests in MTP might produce exception that is hard to interpret by users #51519
  • .NET 10 Blazor Server Hot Reload with dotnet watch is still very slow and here are the numbers to prove it #51185
